name: Kimi to Koi Shite Musubarete
source:
Spring... the season of start. We met again in that season among cherry trees. I wanted to meet you, I wanted to talk to you, I wanted to walk along with you.... One of my wishes has come true. How about others? Our spring has started with full of hopes. Spring... the season of start. Our story starts from here....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106135704/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003754]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
春天…是起始的季节。我们在樱树之间，于这个季节再次相遇。我想见你，想和你说话，想与你并肩同行…我的一个愿望已经实现，其他愿望又会怎样？满怀希望的春天属于我们。春天…是起始的季节。我们的故事就从这里开始…

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106135704/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003754]ErogeShop[/url]]
